image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle view of a wooden bookcase filled with books. The bookcase has multiple shelves (at least three visible levels) packed with colorful book spines. To the right, there is a partial view of another shelving unit or extension containing stacked magazines or thin books. The floor is light-colored wood parquet. The lighting appears warm and indoor.

While it is clearly a tall piece of furniture, the full silhouette showing it is 'notably taller than wide' is not fully visible due to framing. However, the visible structure implies height. Strictly speaking, the full rectangular silhouette is cut off at the top and bottom.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is largely illegible gibberish. While some shapes resemble letters, most are nonsensical squiggles or blurred blobs, typical of AI generation struggling with small text. This is a moderate-to-severe artifact for a bookcase image where text is a primary texture element.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the main bookcase / junction with right-side unit
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical support on the right side of the main bookcase seems to merge ambiguously with the adjacent shelving unit. The perspective lines do not align perfectly, and the boundary between the two furniture pieces is soft and structurally unclear.
The bottom edge of the bookcase does not sit perfectly flat on the floor; there is slight warping where the wood meets the parquet flooring, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or display rack, and to verify the 'wood' material classification.
To rigorously quantify the legibility of text on book spines, which is a major failure mode in AI-generated images of libraries/bookcases.
To check if the books sit correctly on the shelves (depth consistency) and if the shelves recede properly into the background without melting.
To ensure the vertical sides and horizontal shelves form a continuous, rigid structure without floating elements or blurred boundaries.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on book spines
Structural integrity of shelf supports and vertical frames
Geometric consistency of book placement on shelves (no floating books)
Boundary sharpness between the bookcase and the background/floor
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text_gibberish severity. In real photos, even blurry text usually retains character-like structures. Here, many spines show pure noise patterns. Also, verify if the right-side unit is a separate object or a malformed extension of the main case. Check if the fine_grained_classifier distinguishes between 'real wood grain' and 'AI-smudged wood texture'.
